t: What happens to what came before
a: إِذَا أَسْلَمَ الْعَبْدُ فَحَسُنَ إِسْلاَمُهُ يُكَفِّرُ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُلَّ سَيِّئَةٍ كَانَ زَلَفَهَا
p: Idhā aslama-l-ʿabdu fa-ḥasuna islāmuh, yukaffiru-Llāhu ʿanhu kulla sayyiʾatin kāna zalafahā
m: When a servant accepts Islam and makes his Islam good, Allah wipes out from him every bad deed he had put forward before.
